body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Podspeakers presented a round-shape subwoofer called ''the ball'' during CES 2007. It is available in six different colors(silver, yellow, red, blue, white, and black) and weighs 3.75kg.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Niki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Sirh >
